_doc: [v6yard] The hubs' landmark models (planet/sites/hub_landmarks.gd). kinds.<kind>: main / accent are art-kit colour names (cream, white, teal, mint, sky, navy, orange, yellow, red, olive, slate, plum) or #rrggbb; sizes are metres; spin is radians a second while the hub is awake (0 = still); foot is the clear radius the model needs; kit: false falls back to the old thin model. planets.<planet>.<kind> overrides any of these for one planet. states: the look from each hub level upward (broken is dark and still). lods: automatic distance LODs. Which hub has which landmark is data/planets.json hubs[].landmark.kind. See docs/ADJUSTING.md, 'Yard machines and landmarks'.
